title: Hybilides
summary: Raleigh names Hybilides in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Hybilides, whom Halycarnasseus names as Gouernour of Athens at the time of Marathon. The name Plutarch giues for that Gouernour is a gap and was not filled. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
